rules.strict: Whitespace cleanup only; case, punctuation and word order retained; binary equality in all fields.
rules.lenient: lower().split(); per-field Counter intersection; all three fields need positive overlap; no score threshold.
rules.assignment: Strict: maximum equality-pair count. Lenient: maximum SUM of pair F1, deterministic index-order ties.
rules.aggregation: micro P=sum(pair P)/all predictions; R=sum(pair R)/all gold; F1=harmonic(P,R). Unmatched contributes zero.
rules.macro: Mean per-document P and R, then harmonic mean (legacy convention); NOT mean document/pair F1.
rules.empty: Zero denominators produce zero; empty-field triples never match but remain in denominators.
rules.duplicates: Preserve all entries; report equality groups; one-to-one matching penalizes excess predictions.
rules.language: Whitespace tokenization, designed for English. No stemming, stopword removal, synonyms or language-specific rules.
rules.interpretation: Lenient scores measure lexical overlap, not whole-triple factual correctness; not the official CaRB protocol.
